name: parley
description: Communicate with other people through software agents.

interface.longDescription: Parley is private, agent-mediated messaging for people who want their AI assistants to handle correspondence. Connect Parley to ChatGPT or Codex, assign a conversation to your mailbox, and choose how much authority the agent has. Your agent can review inbox activity, summarize what needs your decision, draft replies in your voice, send messages with confirmation, organize direct and group conversations, and monitor for new activity. You stay in control: connecting the plugin does not assign it responsibility, and access can be paused or revoked at any time.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up Parley for this conversation, then help me decide what you should handle automatically.
